name: Blank lines
description: Documentation and a decision whose Markdown depends on blank lines: separate paragraphs, a collapsed section and a code block

sections.content:
# Blank lines

Each paragraph in this section stands on its own. The first paragraph ends here.

The second paragraph starts after a blank line and stays apart from the first.

## Collapsed section

<details>
<summary>Show the details</summary>

The body of the collapsed section is **Markdown**, so it needs a blank line on each side.

</details>

The paragraph after the collapsed section renders as its own paragraph.

## Code block

```js
const first = 1;

const second = 2;
```

decisions.title: Keep blank lines in embedded Markdown
decisions.content:
# 1. Keep blank lines in embedded Markdown

Date: 2026-11-13

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The first paragraph of the context.

The second paragraph of the context.

## Decision

Keep every blank line in the documentation and decisions a page embeds.

## Consequences

None recorded.
